tools.name: business_day
tools.description: Whether a date is a business day in a country (holiday/weekend/make-up workday aware), plus the previous and next business day. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: business_days_add
tools.description: Date that is N business days after (or before, if negative) a start date in a country. Typical use: T+2 settlement, SLA and filing deadlines. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: business_days_count
tools.description: Number of business days in [start, end] inclusive (max 3 years), with the holidays that fell on weekdays. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: holidays
tools.description: All national public holidays for a country and year, with weekend definition and official weekend make-up workdays. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.
